looks.label: Upgrade glow ladder
looks.technique: Glow colour from +7, shine from +11, ancient colour for sets, excellent glow flagged per mesh; the game chooses the glow from level. Item model glow usage: 889 model entries, 420 with a glow object.

looks.label: Named glow palette
looks.technique: One shared list of 45 named colours (values not copied); names are letters and digits; start is refused when default names are missing.

looks.label: Per-mesh glow
looks.technique: Glow and shine limited to named meshes, or all but one hidden mesh.

looks.label: Inventory idle spin
looks.technique: Every item turns while hovered; gamble items turn slowly all the time.

looks.label: Four effect kinds
looks.technique: Object, particle, joint, sprite; each kind has its own create function and its own type names (646 named types in all: 464 object, 98 particle, 31 joint, 53 sprite).

looks.label: Joint tether that follows the nearest target
looks.technique: Joint effect links two points; its target is a copy of the nearest monster or NPC that it follows while the slot holds it, and re-acquires the nearest when gone.

looks.label: Target bar only for the selected target
looks.technique: Bar drawn under the selected name only, and only when the status is not zero (single predicate function).

looks.label: Target bar after attack
looks.technique: Health bar added after the first attack (changelog).

looks.label: Reduce-effects toggle
looks.technique: Options checkbox that cuts effects to raise frame rate.

originals.name: Upgrade Glow Ladder
originals.idea: Gear shows its upgrade through a glow that starts at a middle step and a shine that starts at a higher step.
originals.keep: Stepped glow by upgrade; one colour list.
originals.change: Three steps with a pulse pattern so the tier reads without colour (accessibility). Rows 15 and 16.

originals.name: Named Glow Palette
originals.idea: One shared list of named colours for all gear, refused at start if the defaults are missing.
originals.keep: The single list and the start-time check.
originals.change: Our palette and a contrast check at 375 px. Rows 15 and 16.

originals.name: Tether Line
originals.idea: A dotted line in team colour that links two fighters, follows a copy of the nearest target and re-acquires when the target is gone.
originals.keep: The joint kind, the follow, and the re-acquire.
originals.change: Breaks past the leash; no lightning look. Rows 8 and 4.

originals.name: Target Bar After Hit
originals.idea: A bar shows only for the selected target, is hidden at zero, and appears after the first hit.
originals.keep: Selected-only, hidden at zero, shown after an attack.
originals.change: Segmented bar that fades after a few quiet seconds; half-point tick for 375 px. Row 14.

originals.name: Four Effect Kinds
originals.idea: Hit burst, aura, tether, marker and ground decal, each with its own create path and names in data.
originals.keep: The kinds and their separate create paths.
originals.change: Kinds named by gameplay role. Row 8.

originals.name: Wing Tiers Flight
originals.idea: Four named wing tiers change flight height and landing; flight is an entry gate in data.
originals.keep: Tiers as named steps; the entry gate.
originals.change: Landing ring; flight ends on a hit. Row 22.

originals.name: Kill-Quota Gate
originals.idea: An area opens after a quota of kills across three enemy kinds, counted by the server ledger.
originals.keep: Quota per enemy kind as data.
originals.change: Our own enemy kinds and a visible progress ring. Rows 18 and 23.

originals.name: Inventory Idle Spin
originals.idea: Gear turns while hovered; rare gear keeps a slow spin when idle.
originals.keep: The hover turn and the slow idle spin for rare items.
originals.change: Tilt-and-shimmer instead of a full turn, so the phone view stays calm. Row 15.
